jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Company Overview At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role As Product Manager - you will coordinate the engine that produces everything CoMind puts in front of the outside world — marketing collateral, conference materials, brand content, IFUs, and the claims we make about our products. You will take requests for content from across the business and turn them into finished, correctly reviewed output, keeping a clear, current record of what's in flight, what's overdue, and who it's waiting on. This is a hands-on role focused on the administration and operations of content. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Coordinate marketing collateral production: manage requests, keep templates and source files organised, control versioning, and route sign-off through Product, Commercial, and Regulatory before anything goes out. Own conference materials: booth collateral, printed and digital assets, deadlines, and vendor coordination for events. Generate brand content within established guidelines: copy adaptation, slide assets, and social/web content, escalating anything that needs new creative direction. Administer IFUs (Instructions for Use): keep documents current across product lines, track versions against released product configurations, and route changes through regulatory review. Maintain the claims matrix: keep it up to date, chase evidence and sign-off from Regulatory and Clinical, and flag claims that lack current support. Run the day-to-day operating rhythm for all of the above: a single, current tracker of status, owners, and deadlines across every content work

jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
